summary: Enhance your skills in banking fraud detection and prevention with our comprehensive training program. Safeguard your institution against financial crimes.
lede: Bank fraud detection training helps banking professionals identify suspicious activity, prioritize alerts, and document investigations. It is suited to people working with transactions, customer risk, controls, or investigations who need a repeatable way to assess fraud exposure and decide which cases to escalate. Learners practice fraud-risk scoring, alert triage, evidence preservation, and reporting control gaps through transaction analysis and case documentation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who already work with transactions, controls, customer risk, or investigations and need a stronger bank fraud detection workflow. It suits professionals who can interpret operational records and want to improve analysis, escalation, evidence handling, and reporting without requiring software development skills.
modules: Digital Fraud Analytics and Link Analysis
prerequisites: You should bring experience reviewing banking transactions, customer records, operational controls, or investigation documentation. You do not need to code or configure a production fraud platform. The course uses provided sample transaction data, case records, and templates. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended; Power BI exercises depend on the delivery environment and may use a provided demonstration workspace.
